snippet.title: Vikings Dynasty - Gameplay Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2753930/Vikings_Dynasty/

A gameplay trailer for Vikings Dynasty. Survive in the harsh norse environments and praise the Gods. Become a Jarl, control every aspect of your village and protect your community at all costs. Build and customize ships and explore the fjords in the unforgiving world of Vikings Dynasty. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
